purpose: Make a special case compelling enough to justify an action.
keywords: N / plain clause + とあれば
If it is a request from a friend, I cannot refuse.
If necessary, I will explain as many times as it takes.
If a child is in trouble, I cannot ignore it.
formation: N / plain clause + とあれば
restrictions: Often expresses willingness or necessity under a notable condition.
mistake: It is conditional; the special situation need not already be confirmed.
